name: repo2ds-monorepo
description: Reverse-engineer a design system from an existing React or React Native codebase.
author: Hrishikesh Joshi

scripts.build: npm run build -w @repo2ds/core && npm run build -w @repo2ds/tailwind && npm run build -w @repo2ds/nativewind && npm run build -w @repo2ds/react && npm run build -w @repo2ds/react-native && npm run build -w repo2ds
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && node scripts/copy-readme.mjs --check
scripts.release: npm run verify && npm run clean && npm run build && npm publish -w @repo2ds/core -w @repo2ds/tailwind -w @repo2ds/nativewind -w @repo2ds/react -w @repo2ds/react-native -w repo2ds
